## What DFWin does

DFWin International sources, engineers and ships hotel equipment, tableware, RFID and marine products for cruise lines, shipyards and hotels. Supplying the cruise industry since 2014.

Product sectors:

- Technology: RFID wristbands, key cards and fobs for access, payment and guest identification.
- Hospitality: Carts, trolleys, linens, tableware and in-room equipment for hotels, resorts and cruise ship hotel operations.
- Marine: Mooring ropes, life jackets and deck lighting for ship operators and yards.

More detail: https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/services.html

## Verified figures

- Supplying cruise lines since: 2014
- Stainless steel luggage cages delivered for Quantum of the Seas: 352
- SOLAS approved life jackets supplied in a single order: 2,000
- Royal Caribbean International ships fitted with our turbocharger filters: 21

## How to request a quote

1. Find the products you need in the catalog: https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html (search with https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/catalog.html?q=your+search+term).
2. Note each product ID and the quantity.
3. Send the request with the form at https://sarah-sami-ai-studios.github.io/DFWIN-next/quote.html or by email to braydai@dfwin-intl.com.
4. The sales team replies within one business day.

Prices are not published on the website.
